package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestPlanningReadinessRepositoryIsOneReadOnlyConsistentProjection(t *testing.T) {
	contents, err := os.ReadFile("student_planning_readiness_repo_pg.go")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	source := string(contents)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{IsoLevel: pgx.RepeatableRead, AccessMode: pgx.ReadOnly})",
		"getStudentOnboardingDraft(ctx, tx", "student_onboarding WHERE student_id=$1",
		"student_onboarding_turn_provenance", "student_learning_context c", "p.status='ACTIVE'", "tx.Commit(ctx)",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(source, required) {
			t.Fatalf("planning readiness read is missing %q", required)
		}
	}
	readStart := strings.Index(source, "func (repo *StudentOnboardingRepoPG) ReadPlanningReadiness")
	readSource := source[readStart:]
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"INSERT INTO", "UPDATE ", "DELETE FROM", "student_outbox", "idempotency"} {
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToUpper(readSource), strings.ToUpper(forbidden)) {
			t.Fatalf("read projection contains mutation marker %q", forbidden)
		}
	}
}
